SOURCE CHANGE (approved): replaces DF_IALFS_INDIC UNE_LF used in c1_unemployment_rate.json. Raw: /workspace/skyscraper/unitedstats-warehouse/raw/oecd_20261010T043650Z/DF_IALFS_UNE_M.csv
measure: Unemployment rate, unemployed as % of labour force, ages 15+, seasonally adjusted (UNE_LF_M, PT_LF_SUB)

rules.change: computed in app: end minus start in percentage points; monthly = 3-month average; quarterly = quarter
rules.breaks: status B kept per period as published; yearly-only breaks in breaks_annual, stored as years
rules.quarterly: quarter = mean of its 3 months, only where all 3 months exist, else null; quarter status = union of monthly flags

breaks_annual_note: Carried over from DF_IALFS_INDIC annual only where applicable. CAN: DF_IALFS_UNE_M reproduces DF_IALFS_INDIC exactly (monthly and quarterly, all periods; also USA, JPN), so CAN 1975 kept. DEU (1998,2004,2009,2010,2019), FRA (2004,2013,2020), ITA (2003,2004,2020) NOT carried over: UNE_M values differ from INDIC for those countries (different monthly estimates, e.g. DEU 2010-19 mean -0.27 pt, FRA 2000-09 +0.40 pt), so INDIC annual breaks cannot be assumed to apply; DF_IALFS_UNE_M publishes no B flags for them. Breaks in UNE_M are carried only as published per month (status).

status_codes.note: OECD status A (normal) stored as null
